elder.say: {leader}... you came. Then you felt it too. The hearth-fires are dying.
elder.speaker: Elder

elder.say: Three nights ago a wyrm tore the Ember Crystal from the shrine and fled into the cave beyond the pass.
elder.speaker: Elder

elder.say: Without it, winter will swallow the valley. Will you bring it back?
elder.speaker: Elder

elder.say: Every hour the fires grow dimmer. Decide quickly.
elder.speaker: Elder

elder.say: Bless you. I have told the guard at the pass to let you through.
elder.speaker: Elder

elder.say: The hermit in the quiet house kept a key to the cave's lower door. Ask him for it.
elder.speaker: Elder

elder.say: The cave lies east, past the mountain pass. The hermit has the key to its depths.
elder.speaker: Elder

elder.say: You slew the beast? Then the crystal still lies in its den. Fetch it, quickly!
elder.speaker: Elder

elder.say: The Ember Crystal! I can feel the warmth from here.
elder.speaker: Elder

elder.say: You have saved us all, {leader}. Let the hearths burn again!
elder.speaker: Elder

pass_guard.say: Halt. The pass is closed by the Elder's order. Nothing good lives east of here.
pass_guard.speaker: Guard

pass_guard.say: If you have business beyond, take it up with the Elder in Emberfall.
pass_guard.speaker: Guard

pass_guard_open.say: The Elder vouched for you. Go on through... and watch the skies.
pass_guard_open.speaker: Guard

pass_guard_open.say: You came back! Nobody comes back from that cave.
pass_guard_open.speaker: Guard

hermit.say: ...Go away. Unless the Elder sent you, I have nothing to say.
hermit.speaker: Hermit

hermit.say: The Elder sent you? Hmph. Then you'll want this.
hermit.speaker: Hermit

hermit.say: The lower door in Ember Cave. Don't lose it. I only made one.
hermit.speaker: Hermit

hermit.say: The door is on the far side of the first cavern, up the slope. The key fits. Go.
hermit.speaker: Hermit

hermit.say: You opened it. Then there's nothing left to do but finish it.
hermit.speaker: Hermit

vex_recruit.say: You're the ones the Elder sent after the wyrm? You'll need someone who understands fire.
vex_recruit.speaker: Vex

vex_recruit.say: Four is all a road can carry. Come back when you have room.
vex_recruit.speaker: Vex

juno_recruit.say: Good ale, warm fire. Bad time to be a wanderer with no fight to pick.
juno_recruit.speaker: Juno

juno_recruit.say: Heard you're going after the wyrm. I've been waiting for a reason to crack my knuckles.
juno_recruit.speaker: Juno

juno_recruit.say: Your party's full up. Drop someone and come find me.
juno_recruit.speaker: Juno

juno_recruit.say: I'll be here. The ale isn't going anywhere.
juno_recruit.speaker: Juno

patron.say: Hic. The wyrm breathes fire, they say. Bring something cold.
patron.speaker: Patron

patron.say: Hic. To the heroes! Another round!
patron.speaker: Patron

villager_1.say: The Elder has been asking for you. His house is the middle one on the north row.
villager_1.speaker: Villager

villager_1.say: You're really going into the cave? Buy armor first. The Whetstone is south of here.
villager_1.speaker: Villager

villager_1.say: Is it true? The fires are back? Oh, thank you!
villager_1.speaker: Villager

villager_2.say: I saw the wyrm! It was THIS big! It was red and it was ON FIRE!
villager_2.speaker: Child

villager_2.say: I already told you {flag:child_stories} times. Go DO something about it!
villager_2.speaker: Child

villager_3.say: Spiders bite poison. Carry Antidotes. Bats sing you to sleep. Hit them to wake up.
villager_3.speaker: Old Woman

villager_3.say: Skeletons? Fire. Always fire. Or holy light if the girl knows Dia yet.
villager_3.speaker: Old Woman

cave_sealed_door.say: A heavy door sealed with an iron lock. It needs a key.
You fit the Cave Key into the lock. It turns with a groan.
The door stands open. Stairs lead down.

golem_ambush.say: The cave floor shudders. A shape of stone unfolds from the wall!
The golem crumbles into rubble. The way ahead is clear.

boss_wyrm.say: A wall of heat. Coiled around the glowing crystal, the Ember Wyrm raises its head.
You should not have come, little embers.
boss_wyrm.speaker: Ember Wyrm

boss_wyrm.say: The wyrm collapses. Where it lay, the Ember Crystal pulses with gentle warmth.

crystal_pickup.say: The Ember Crystal is warm to the touch.
Bring it back to the Elder in Emberfall.
